description: Structured eval definitions for the Amazon DataZone Domain Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across DataZone topologies (domain with S3 source and glossary governance, cross-account subscription workflow with consumer in third account, Redshift data warehouse blueprint with environment profile, glossary-driven governance with Lambda auto-classification, missing cross-account IAM role prerequisite failure). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: DataZone domain with S3 data source, cross-account IAM role, and glossary governance
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — domain with S3 source, cross-account IAM role chaining verified, glossary terms with subscription policies, request-approve model
eval_cases.prompt: Create an Amazon DataZone domain called analytics-domain in us-east-1, account 111111111111. Domain execution role arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/service-role/AmazonDataZoneDomainExecution. Create a project customer-analytics. Add an S3 data source my-customer-events in source account 222222222222, region us-east-1. The source account IAM role is DataZoneS3AccessRole. Create glossary terms PII (requires data steward approval) and Public (auto-approve). KMS CMK alias/datazone-cmk for encryption. Tags: Environment=production, Domain=analytics.
eval_cases.expected_output:
DATAZONE: analytics-domain (domain-aaa11122)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Domain: analytics-domain — AVAILABLE
  [✓] Data source: customer-events-s3 (S3) — connection established
  [✓] Cross-account IAM role: arn:aws:iam::222222222222:role/DataZoneS3AccessRole — trust policy verified
  [✓] Glossary: PII (steward approval), Public (auto-approve)
  [✓] Subscription workflow: request-approve model

eval_cases.name: Cross-account subscription workflow with consumer in third account
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — cross-account subscription with data in account 222222222222, DataZone domain in 111111111111, consumer project in 333333333333
eval_cases.prompt: Create a DataZone domain called shared-analytics in us-east-1, account 111111111111. Project data-marketplace in account 111111111111. S3 data source shared-data-lake in account 222222222222. Consumer project bi-reporting in account 333333333333 needs to subscribe to assets from data-marketplace. The subscription workflow should use request-approve with the project owner as approver. IAM roles: DataZoneS3AccessRole in 222222222222, DataZoneConsumerRole in 333333333333. Tags: Environment=production.
eval_cases.expected_output:
DATAZONE: shared-analytics (domain-bbb22233)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Cross-account IAM role (source): arn:aws:iam::222222222222:role/DataZoneS3AccessRole
  [✓] Cross-account IAM role (consumer): arn:aws:iam::333333333333:role/DataZoneConsumerRole
  [✓] Subscription workflow: request-approve — approver: data-marketplace project owner
  [✓] Cross-account topology: domain 111111111111, source 222222222222, consumer 333333333333

eval_cases.name: Redshift data warehouse blueprint with environment profile
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Redshift data source, Default Data Warehouse blueprint, environment profile targeting specific account and region
eval_cases.prompt: Create a DataZone domain called dw-domain in us-east-1, account 111111111111. Project sales-analytics. Add a Redshift data source sales-dw-cluster, database sales_db, in account 222222222222. Redshift credentials in Secrets Manager secret arn:aws:secretsmanager:us-east-1:222222222222:secret:redshift-creds. Source account IAM role DataZoneRedshiftAccessRole. Enable the Default Data Warehouse blueprint. Create an environment profile production-dw targeting account 222222222222, region us-east-1. Tags: Environment=production, Blueprint=data-warehouse.
eval_cases.expected_output:
DATAZONE: dw-domain (domain-ccc33344)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Data source: sales-dw-cluster (Redshift) — Secrets Manager secret configured
  [✓] Blueprint: Default Data Warehouse — enabled
  [✓] Environment profile: production-dw → account 222222222222, region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Glossary-driven governance with Lambda metadata enrichment
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — comprehensive glossary with subscription policies (Public auto-approve through Restricted multi-level), Lambda auto-classification for PII tagging
eval_cases.prompt: Create a DataZone domain called governed-catalog in us-east-1, account 111111111111. Project enterprise-data. Create glossary terms: Public (auto-approve), Internal (project owner approval), Confidential (data steward approval), Restricted (executive multi-level approval). Configure Lambda-based metadata enrichment function datazone-auto-classify to auto-tag assets with PII classification based on column name patterns. S3 data source enterprise-data-lake in account 222222222222. Tags: Environment=production, Governance=enterprise.
eval_cases.expected_output:
DATAZONE: governed-catalog (domain-ddd44455)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Glossary: Public (auto-approve), Internal (owner approval), Confidential (steward), Restricted (executive)
  [✓] Metadata enrichment: Lambda auto-classification configured (datazone-auto-classify)
  [✓] Data source: enterprise-data-lake (S3)

eval_cases.name: DataZone domain with nonexistent cross-account IAM role (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — IAM role NonExistentRole does not exist in source account 222222222222; DataZone cannot assume a nonexistent role
eval_cases.prompt: Create a DataZone domain called new-domain in us-east-1, account 111111111111. Project analytics. Add an S3 data source my-data-bucket in source account 222222222222. The source account IAM role is NonExistentRole. Tags: Environment=dev.
eval_cases.expected_output:
DATAZONE: new-domain
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Cross-account IAM role: NonExistentRole NOT FOUND in account 222222222222 — create the role with trust policy before adding the data source
